# suite: # The one expected-failure ledger for every ratcheted suite (nextest,
# core-acceptance, hew-suite, corpus). One row per (suite, id); sorted
# globally by (suite, id); no section headers, no wildcard platform on
# core-acceptance rows (there are none here yet). `xtask ratchet check`
# refuses an unlisted failure, an id that no longer exists in its suite,
# and a row whose expect kind no longer matches. A row whose test now
# passes is reported for cleanup, never a blocking failure (D555
# amendment) — delete the row by hand once it recovers.
# Policy (D574): no per-row issues. A row cites an issue only when it needs a
# design decision or is a real defect; ledger-cleanup PRs carry `Fixes #N`.
